Which dictionary differences stop the round and which are only reported

round_schema_verdict.Rd

Five of the seven codes change what the round reads and one of them — a @READONLY that fell — means a requester may have typed applied into the outcome, so the register could be carrying a success nobody produced. The other two cannot: a field the round ignores does not corrupt its reading, and choices that could not be compared are the declared consequence of calling without the fleet list.

Usage

round_schema_verdict(differences)

Arguments

differences

The differences of compare_dictionary().

Value

A list with blocks, blocking and tolerated.
